# Claw BBQ Downtown Dubai

> Claw BBQ is an American-style barbecue and crab shack at Souk Al Bahar in Downtown Dubai, a short walk from the Burj Khalifa. Opened in 2008, the souk pairs traditional Arabesque architecture with waterfront terraces overlooking the Dubai Fountain, and houses more than 100 shops alongside some 22 restaurants and cafés. A footbridge links it directly to The Dubai Mall, and around 900 parking spaces serve the complex.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Downtown Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Claw BBQ is an American-style barbecue and crab-shack restaurant at Souk Al Bahar in Downtown Dubai, close to Burj Khalifa. MENASCO prepared the design drawings for the restaurant on behalf of the interior contractor, providing the technical documentation for its fit-out. MENASCO also carried out the electrical and mechanical works for the same outlet, giving the project continuity from design through to installation.
